en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a European riverside town with a row of multi‑story historic buildings along an embankment. Behind them rises a steep wooded hill with rocky outcrops, on top of which stands a fortified complex with walls, bastions, and towers. A funicular or inclined railway runs straight up the hillside toward the fortress. In the lower left corner there is an inset graphic advertisement for a hotel or entertainment establishment, and along the bottom margin is handwritten script identifying the location.
